subject: general
question: Kalpana-1 is a __________ satellite
solution:
The correct answer is __**meteorological**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalpana-1** is a meteorological satellite launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• It was originally named METSAT-1 and was later renamed to honor Kalpana Chawla, the first woman of Indian origin in space.
 
• The satellite was launched on **September 12, 2002**.
 
• Kalpana-1 is primarily used for weather forecasting, monitoring, and data collection for meteorological purposes.
 
• It plays a crucial role in disaster management and in providing accurate weather reports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The satellite operates in the geostationary orbit at a longitude of 74° E.
 
• Kalpana-1 carries Very High Resolution Radiometer (VHRR) and Data Relay Transponder (DRT) payloads.
 
• ISRO has launched several other meteorological satellites, including the INSAT series, to enhance weather prediction capabilities.
 
• These satellites contribute significantly to the study of climate change and environmental monitoring.
